construction.notes: Queue shows NO constructionStart, no fisApproved; not in EIA-860M; CCN 59183 still in SOAH paper hearing (not granted). A dense Sentinel-2 time series at the collector complex (N of US-180, ~32.77,-101.555) shows a clear ground-disturbance ramp: bare rangeland through 2025-11-02 and 2026-02-03; a cleared/plowed rectangle emerges 2026-03-29; a bright graded pad is established and expanding by 2026-05-31; and a ~1 km bright graded area by 2026-07-03/2026-07-20. IMPORTANT CALIBRATION: the bright feature reads as bare/graded SOIL or a gravel pad — PV panels read DARK (like the existing ENGIE block at the W edge), and NO panels are yet visible. The pad is as consistent with the WETT collector-station/switchyard footprint as with generator solar site prep. Monotonic growth (Mar->May->Jul, same location, hard geometric edges) rules out a seasonal field and supports grading onset ~Q2 2026 — ahead of the CCN 59183 transmission TIF window (Aug 2026-Apr 2027). Cannot separate Lyra vs the co-located Juno 3/Antila collector work at S2 resolution. The existing operating solar at the W edge (ENGIE Long Draw and/or adjacent existing sites) is NOT Lyra.
